title: Asset4D-Bench: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Editable 3D and 4D Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2611.33728v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A cart can follow its reference trajectory while its cargo floats above the deck. Asset4D-Bench tests whether coding agents recover objects, motion and interactions from visual references as editable Blender scenes. Its 114 conditions span image editing, video reconstruction with matched full or partial starter assets, and independently selected from-scratch tasks. We independently reopen projects and measure them against native reference states. The 228 archived scores include original delivery outcomes and versioned measures of scene quality. On 24 from-scratch tasks, each model earns full dynamics credit on 14. Of these, three GPT-6.1-Sol and eight GPT-6-Astra reconstructions earn zero relation points. Under the fixed scoring weights, relations contribute 5.15 points to the 6.50-point Sol-minus-Astra difference in mean recovered fidelity. translated_title: Asset4D-Bench：面向可编辑3D与4D重建的编码智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 一辆小车能够沿其参考轨迹运动，同时其货物悬浮在甲板上方。Asset4D-Bench 测试编码智能体能否从视觉参考中恢复物体、运动和交互，并将其重建为可编辑的 Blender 场景。该基准包含 114 个测试条件，涵盖图像编辑、配有匹配的完整或部分初始资产的视频重建，以及独立选取的从零开始构建的任务。我们独立重新打开各项目，并根据原始参考状态进行测量。228 个存档评分包括原始交付结果以及版本化的场景质量度量。在 24 个从零开始任务中，每个模型在 14 个任务上获得了完整的动力学得分。其中，三个 GPT-6.1-Sol 重建结果和八个 GPT-6-Astra 重建结果的关系项得分为零。在固定评分权重下，关系项为 Sol 相对 Astra 在平均恢复保真度上 6.50 分的差距贡献了 5.15 分。由于各存档运行在执行和恢复策略上存在差异，无法对 s（原文在此处截断）进行因果估计。
tldr: Asset4D-Bench 提出一个包含114个测试条件的基准，用于评估编码智能体从视觉参考重建可编辑3D/4D Blender场景的能力，发现各模型虽能较好恢复动力学行为，但在物体间关系重建上存在显著缺陷，且该缺陷是模型间保真度差距的主要来源。
en_tdlr: Asset4D-Bench introduces a 114-condition benchmark evaluating coding agents' ability to reconstruct editable 3D/4D Blender scenes from visual references, revealing that while models achieve solid dynamics recovery, they exhibit significant deficits in object relation reconstruction, which accounts for the main fidelity gap between models.
